role: The redstone torch, lit (76) and unlit (75): an inverter that turns off when its support is powered, with the 8-toggles-in-60-ticks burnout list, and neighbour notifications when it changes.
scope_reason: In scope: the redstone torch is craftable and placeable; its onBlockAdded and breakBlock notify the six neighbours' neighbours (block updates that liquids and falling blocks react to), it ticks randomly, and the lit torch emits particles. Only the power it emits reaches nothing.

members.name: field_150112_b
members.note: burnout history; never fed without power

members.name: onBlockAdded
members.note: BlockTorch's facing when meta 0, then the lit torch's six neighbour rounds

members.name: breakBlock
members.note: the lit torch (field_150113_a) runs the six neighbour rounds on removal; a static liquid two cells away turns flowing (liq-wash-s1)

members.name: updateTick
members.note: case 76: BlockTorch's part via block_torch_update_tick; the state machine writes nothing

members.name: onNeighborBlockChange
members.note: BlockTorch's support drop; the lit torch's schedule needs power (func_150110_m), which is 0 with redstone off, and the unlit torch (75) is never made in survival: rs-lever-s1 pulls the walls from under two torches

members.name: randomDisplayTick
members.note: the reddust particle with its three draws; test_rendertick matches every spawn and every particle field per tick against the oracle's log in out/java/rendertick/fx_redstone (12 reddust spawns); clientworld.c keeps the draws for the client world
